user.title: Sign in to your Apple Account
user.description: One sign-in covers your iPhones, iPads, Macs and family devices as well as AirTags and other Find My tags. Home Assistant signs in as an emulated Mac: it downloads Apple's macOS ADI library from Apple (about 3.5 MB) and adds one "MacBook Pro" with a serial starting with 0FMAHA to your Apple Account's device list. Your password is stored unencrypted in Home Assistant's .storage folder, because Apple's session renewal needs it.

2fa_method.title: Two-factor authentication
2fa_method.description: Where should Apple send the code?

unlock.title: Unlock your tag keys
unlock.description: Your tags' keys are stored in your iCloud Keychain. Choose one of your Apple devices and enter its screen passcode (iPhone PIN or Mac login password, not your Apple Account password). It's used once and never stored. Apple locks keychain recovery after repeated wrong passcodes; attempts left here: {attempts_left}.

select.title: Choose what to track
select.description: Select the devices and tags to track. Each one gets a map tracker and sensors. Every update asks the selected devices for a fresh location, which uses a little battery.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Apple ended the session for {username}. Enter the password to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: Apple refused the email or password.
error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Apple, or Apple is temporarily refusing sign-ins. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.
error.machine_failed: Could not prepare the emulated Mac (downloading Apple's library or registering with Apple failed). See the log.

abort.already_configured: This Apple Account is already set up.
abort.security_key_unsupported: This account uses a hardware security key for two-factor authentication, which isn't supported yet.
abort.no_devices: No Find My devices or tags were found on this account.
abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but the device list or the iCloud Keychain could not be loaded. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.no_findmy_token: Signed in, but Apple didn't issue the Find My tokens. Try again later.
abort.too_many_passcode_attempts: Too many wrong passcodes. Stopped to protect your account from a keychain lockout.

data_description.away_min_interval: Used right outside a zone. The interval grows with distance up to the longest one (reached 50 km from the nearest zone). Each update makes the devices fetch a GPS position.
data_description.tag_interval: Tags are located at most this often, however short the device intervals are.

error.min_above_max: The shortest interval must not be longer than the longest one.
